main_text.p: malum, antennas, uela, remos, anchoras, gubernaculū, cæterasque partes omnes cõparet: & quæ cuique pars loco accommodanda sit, designet. uel ut exemplum propius nostris ex fontibus hauriamus, si uelit quis Iuris ciuilis priuati summam exponere, is personarum primùm omnes tanquã ordines ac differentias exponat oportet: liberos seruos, ingenuos liber-tinos, patresfamiliâs filiosfa. uiros mulieres, puberes impuberes, furiosos constantes: secundo loco rerū species ac formas omnes, diuinas, humanas, sacras, sanctas, religio

page.notes: The running head is printed IVRISCONSVLTVS.; the u/v spelling is normalised to IURISCONSULTUS. A small mark "e" stands at the foot left of the catchword, probably a stray mark or the start of the catchword line, not transcribed as text. "filiosfa." is printed with a full stop at the line end, and the word continues on the next line ("uiros"); the reading "filiosfamiliâs" is not certain. The catchword "fas," is taken as the word printed at the foot right. The left margin has no notes; the small marks on the right are not text.
